title: dryopteris hawaiiensis
intro: Dryopteris hawaiiensis, commonly known as Hawaiian shield fern, is a species of fern native to Hawaii. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris hawaiiensis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and applications of this plant.
